## 2. Scope of Services — Schedule 1

### Objective
> **To Increase access to financial products and services for assigned MSMEs using the official PRUDEV II tools.**

### Tasks
- Support MSMEs to develop financial improvement action plans
- Support MSMEs in the preparation of bankable documents

---

## 3. Deliverables

| Task # | Deliverable Description | Due Date |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Ensure the assigned MSMEs are supported to develop Financial Improvement Action plans for the gaps identified from the previous activities** (clustered as according to your specialization: *Financial Records and Documentation*; *Cashflow management and Financial Discipline*; *Business Plan and Financial projection development*; *Collateral and alternative security Solutions*; *Banking Relationship and Financial institution Linkage*; *Financial Literacy, Costing and Management Capacity building*; *Loan application and Investment Readiness*; *Debt Management and credit growth and Formulation, Audit and Certification*) and MSMEs are supported in the preparation of Bankable documents. | Final day of each session |
| **2** | **Summary Report of activity** (max 3 pages) highlighting major findings, challenges, and preliminary recommendations across the MSMEs. | Within 3 days after completing assignment |
| **3** | **Signed attendance or confirmation from each MSME**. | Per session |
| **4** | **Technical Report with summary of engagement days and MSMEs covered**. | With invoice submission |

## 4. Payment Terms — Schedule 2

- **Rate:** As per the agreed terms and conditions in the contract (standard UGX 60,000/day up to maximum 10 days)
- **Total Possible Sessions per day:** 2
- **Transport:** Only transport beyond 7 kilometers from the District/City headquarters will be reimbursed based on receipt.
- **Payment Terms:** Paid upon submission and approval of:
  - Approved summary report
  - Approved Invoice and signed timesheet
